findings.reason: taken literally the gate requires the worker to catalogue documents the section exists to exclude, and a reviewer comparing the graph against the record would find either unexcluded rows or rows the done-when says must be present.
findings.text: s4's done-when requires "every row of the census is catalogued" while the Delivers text bounds the work to "every signal-list and self-description document in the census"; the census the plan names holds other roles, verified in `~/.cache/imas-codex-codac-uda/document-census/signal-lists-sample.tsv` as 3 `presentation`, 1 `meeting` and 1 `guideline` rows beside the signal-list and sdd rows, and a title search for "Signal List" and "SDD" will carry such rows into the fuller census too

findings.reason: the target class decides which node the write creates and what the landing record counts, so the wrong reading produces a graph the next pipeline stage cannot join on.
findings.text: s4 says the graph links each document "to each archive control system it is matched to" and its negative control asks that a document be "matched to no control system", but its done-when counts matches at "first-level control-breakdown nodes", so the endpoint names two different target classes for the same relationship; the plan never defines an archive control system and §1 (line 45) distinguishes control systems from the PBS, so a worker cannot tell whether the link points at a `ControlNode` or at the first-level plant-structure/PBS node

findings.reason: a node dispatched on this plan would open the named path, find a two-page sample, and either measure against it believing it is the census, or stall on an unnamed fuller export the coordinator has no written spec for.
findings.text: s4 anchors its sole declared input at the directory `~/.cache/imas-codex-codac-uda/document-census/` and states that census "reads every page of a signal-list title search and a self-description title search", but that directory today holds only `signal-lists-sample.tsv`, whose own header records "pages 1-2 of an unfinished result (has_more true; 23 and 19 rows withheld by permissions on those pages)" and "first page only" for the self-description search; the every-page census §4's done-when measures does not exist at that path and is not distinguished from the sample by name

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: a finding — the single input §4 anchors at `~/.cache/imas-codex-codac-uda/document-census/` currently resolves to the two-page sample whose own header says it is an unfinished search, not the every-page census §4 describes.
rubric_items.done_when: a finding — s4's done-when demands "every row of the census is catalogued", which is broader than the section's own scope ("every signal-list and self-description document") and would have the node catalogue rows of other roles the census holds.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — s2's record is a tracked file, and s4's private artefacts (hand-check verdicts under `~/.cache/imas-codex-codac-uda/document-census/hand-checks/`) sit on a durable home path rather than a scratch directory.
rubric_items.naming: pass — the changed s2 and s4 text introduces no plan labels, stage names, ticket numbers or version tags, and the s4 followups `id="followups"` anchor resolves.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — s4's body and negative control speak of "archive control system" while its done-when counts "first-level control-breakdown nodes", leaving the link's target class undetermined; the rest of s2's reasoning holds (its stated metric is computable from the live graph's signal-to-control memberships joined to the census's `pbs_codes`, and it prescribes no implementation).
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — s2 delivers one research record and s4 delivers one catalogue of documents linked to plant systems; the additions s2 now enumerates are the contents of that one record, not a second deliverable.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — s2 declares no upstream and s4 declares `iter-plant-signal-ontology#s3`, which is the section that introduces the catalogued-document form s4 writes into; the description-separation the s2 text names as a precondition has already landed (iter-signal-context-and-enrichment comment: r-20261122T165053944927-keep-feed-descriptions-beside-generated-ones at head 3e290e15), so no new edge is owed.
